units.spokenText:
Six crops: range, time basis and sensitive stage

millimetres of crop water need per total growing season, indicative

High, Medium are approximate comparison labels in this example, not universal rankings or drought-sensitivity categories. Ranges overlap. Cabbage replaces the broad leafy-crop rule; no High, Medium category is assigned to it.

Maize (corn). five hundred to eight hundred millimetres over the whole growing season. Tasseling, silking and grain filling. High.

Wheat. four hundred fifty to six hundred fifty millimetres over the whole growing season. Flowering and grain filling. Medium.

Tomato. four hundred to eight hundred millimetres over the whole growing season. Flowering and fruit development. High.

Potato. five hundred to seven hundred millimetres over the whole growing season. Tuber formation and growth. High.

Onion. three hundred fifty to five hundred fifty millimetres over the whole growing season. Bulb formation. Medium.

Cabbage (documented leafy-crop example). three hundred fifty to five hundred millimetres over the whole growing season. Maintain suitable moisture through head development; timing must be checked locally. Specific documented example.
